format: DanceFlow Studio/Custom competitions, who may change the running order
requirement: Running-order changes require an explicit event-level grant (reorder, reorder_in_window) held by a named person, granted only by the event owner level with a reason and ended with a reason; no grant means nobody can reorder; managers, admins, staff and platform admins have no implicit right; declared-body events are refused until a body profile defines authority.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future event_competition_schedule_authorities table and grant RPCs; authority check as the first step of the apply RPC. can_manage_event_competition is not the authorization.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Separate table with the same conventions as the OD-06 designations in PR 834; whether to merge the tables is an open coordinator question (Q7).
decision_refs: OD-26 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: controlled, audited mid-event running-order changes, design-level draft; retrospective audit PR #795)
